After his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[Battle of Khar Delba]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Horak-mul]] was buried in a '''sarcophagus''' that featured markings forming a near-complete record of his achievements. The sarcophagus was located on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where it was eventually found by members of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the era of the [[Galactic War]].
